header.bigTitle: A website for your business in 5–14 days
header.text: Modern websites and online stores that help customers find you on Google and contact you easily. The quote is free and tailored to your business. Call me and we will work out what you need.

aboutHome.smallTitle: FROM A PHONE CALL TO A FINISHED WEBSITE
aboutHome.text: We start with a short conversation about your business: what you do, who your customers are and what kind of website you need. Based on that I prepare a free quote. The price depends on the size of the site and the features needed, so every quote is tailored to a specific business.
aboutHome.text2: The whole process usually takes 5 to 14 days. I need texts, photos and feedback from you, and if you do not have them, I will suggest how to prepare them. The domain and hosting are paid separately, but I will help you choose and set them up. In the end you get a site ready to go, a user guide and an invoice.

offer.text: Need a website, or maybe an online store? Since 2018 I have been building websites and stores for businesses that are meant to bring in enquiries and sales. The quote is always free, and the price depends on the size of the project and the features you need.
offer.websitesText: From a simple business card site to a large portal. Fast, good-looking websites that work well on phones and are easy to edit yourself. Google optimisation is included from day one.
offer.storesText: Online stores that are fast, clear and sell 24/7. I set up payments, shipping and integrations, and managing the store is simple even for someone with no experience. I work with WooCommerce, among others.
offer.graphicText: I help you be visible where your customers are looking: I set up your Google Business Profile, Google Ads and Meta Ads, run social media and create content.
offer.administrationText: You are not left alone after launch. I take care of updates, backups, fixes and new content, and if something goes wrong, just call.
offer.seoText: I take care of your business's visibility on Google. I optimise websites and stores, including for local search, so customers in your area find you first. The effects are long-term, not just for as long as an ad runs.
offer.aiText: I bring AI in where it saves time and money: assistants and chatbots on your site, automatic replies to enquiries, integrations of your store and website with e-mail, calendar, CRM and databases, plus content and product description generation. Practical solutions, not gimmicks.

clients.text: Trust my experience and join the ranks of my satisfied clients! I pay attention to every detail to deliver projects that truly work and make an impact. With positive reviews and great results, I know I can help your business soar online.

contact.text: The quickest way to discuss your needs is over the phone. The consultation and quote are free, with no obligation. I will answer your questions and suggest which solution is best for you. If you prefer, send me an email.

cookies.title: We respect your privacy
cookies.text: We use cookies that are necessary for the site to work. With your consent we also use Google Analytics to measure traffic and improve the website. You can change your choice at any time.
cookies.necessaryDesc: Remember your cookie choice. The site does not work properly without them, so they cannot be turned off.
cookies.analyticsDesc: Anonymous visit statistics: which pages are viewed and where visitors come from. Data is processed by Google. The script does not load without your consent.

aboutMe.text1: Mutual understanding and a shared definition of goals are the keys to success. I constantly seek the best solutions and am not afraid of unconventional ideas. Mediocrity does not satisfy me, and I strive for the same for my clients.
aboutMe.text2: I'm Amadeusz Grzesiak, a front-end developer focused on React JS. After graduating from Wrocław University of Technology (2017), I started at Promatic, one of the leading companies in the Polish gambling industry: a game presentation platform, product websites and online games featuring Mariusz Pudzianowski and Zenek Martyniuk, among others. From 2020 to 2022 at Databout I built Databout Tools, a land analysis tool, and a public consultation application (PPGIS). In 2022–2023, through Sii, I worked for the Norwegian company TU Media, a leader in technology content. Today, as part of the FedEx team, I develop web applications for a global logistics company.
aboutMe.text3: I also run my own company, Amadeo Media: company websites, online stores and web applications, plus SEO. My work includes sexshoponline.pl and seksowna-bielizna.pl (e-commerce), harasimowiczlegal.pl (law firm), zlotalyzeczka.pl (wedding venue and catering) and praca.info, a job listings portal. I combine experience from large projects with a freelancer's approach: fast, direct and focused on results, meaning traffic, enquiries and sales.
aboutMe.text4: All my projects are built using the latest web technologies. This enables me to provide my clients with top-tier solutions that meet the latest standards and market requirements. I continuously develop my skills by taking on new challenges and participating in various courses and training. As a result, I stay updated on the latest industry trends and can offer my clients the best and most modern solutions.

seoLuban.metaDescription: Are you interested in effective website positioning in Lubań? Increase your visibility on Google, outpace the competition, and gain new clients. Order a free SEO audit!
seoLuban.heroText: Do you want your business to be visible on the first page of search results? I offer professional website positioning in Lubań and the surrounding areas. I help local businesses achieve high rankings, increase traffic, and acquire valuable inquiries from clients.
seoLuban.aboutText1: A modern website alone won't bring profits if no one visits it. For your business to grow, effective website positioning is essential. Lubań is a market where local companies increasingly fight for a leading position on Google. My job is to make your offer appear highest when a potential client searches for the services you provide.
seoLuban.aboutText2: As part of our cooperation, I implement dedicated SEO strategies tailored to the specifics of the local market in Lower Silesia. I select high-potential sales keywords (e.g., *"mechanic Lubań"*, *"hairdresser Lubań"* or *"construction services Lubań"*), optimize technical code, and build a strong link profile.
seoLuban.featuresHeading: What is included in Google website positioning?
seoLuban.feature1Text: I thoroughly analyze technical errors and the code structure of your website. I check what blocks your site from entering the TOP 10.
seoLuban.feature2Text: I choose keywords that your potential clients from Lubań enter into the search engine. I focus on phrases that generate real profits.
seoLuban.feature3Text: I speed up page loading, ensure full responsiveness, improve meta tags, and optimize Core Web Vitals.
seoLuban.feature4Text: I create unique, valuable texts that engage users while providing perfectly optimized content for Google bots.
seoLuban.feature5Text: I increase company visibility in the region. I optimize the company profile in Google Maps (Google My Business), drawing traffic right from your neighborhood.
seoLuban.whyHeading: Why is local SEO the best investment for businesses from Lubań?
seoLuban.why1Text: People typing local phrases into Google are looking for services "right now". A well-positioned website captures these valuable leads.
seoLuban.why2Text: Most local companies neglect SEO. By investing in website positioning, you gain a massive advantage in the Lubań region.
seoLuban.why3Text: Unlike paid Ads, organic positioning brings stable traffic even after the main optimization work is completed.
seoLuban.why4Text: I act transparently. Every month you will check precise visibility increases and the positions of key phrases.
seoLuban.stepsHeading: How do I position websites step by step?
seoLuban.step1Text: I analyze the current technical state of the website and local competition.
seoLuban.step2Text: I select precise phrases with conversion and sales potential.
seoLuban.step3Text: I implement technical fixes, speed up the website, and expand the texts.
seoLuban.step4Text: I acquire valuable links that increase domain authority in the eyes of Google.
seoLuban.step5Text: I constantly research user behavior and optimize ranking positions.

seoLuban.ctaText: Don't let competing companies take over your clients in the search engine. Contact me, and I will prepare a free analysis for you and suggest how to effectively push your site to the top positions.
